name: awk
description: Filters standard input with an AWK program, optionally splitting fields on the supplied delimiter. The program runs with file and command access: getline reads files, print/printf redirections write files, and system() executes commands. The contract declares that command execution as a process effect, so untrusted programs need explicit `undeclared` gate approval plus a grant carrying `process.exec`; file grants alone are refused. The gate verdict is advisory and the sandbox narrows the surrounding file and network grants, but neither separately confines the child command.
